note: Unusually thin week: Fallon, Seth Meyers, Bill Maher, and John Oliver were all on summer break, and Colbert's Late Show has ended entirely. Jon Stewart only anchors The Daily Show on Mondays now (dark this week), so most material came from Jimmy Kimmel's slot, guest-hosted all week by Tiffany Haddish. Also checked Byron Allen's Comics Unleashed, Graham Norton, Jonathan Ross, and John Mulaney's Everybody's Live this week: Norton and Ross are both between seasons, Mulaney's Season 2 hasn't premiered, and no quotable Comics Unleashed monologue lines surfaced beyond guest listings — so the one addition is a stray Andy Cohen zinger from Watch What Happens Live.

jokes.topic: Trump's sparsely attended state fair appearance
jokes.joke: Trump said the event was going to be, and I quote, 'packed to the brim.' Well, let's see how that worked out for him.
jokes.context: Cut to footage of a near-empty venue.

jokes.topic: Trump delaying his July 4th speech for weather
jokes.joke: Trump was forced to delay his Fourth of July speech due to the hot and stormy weather. In fact, some MAGA fans had to seek shelter in the African-American history museum. You're welcome, again.

jokes.topic: Trump calling FIFA president Gianni Infantino about a player suspension
jokes.joke: The first time he's ever defended a Black person—and it's surprising since Trump doesn't know anything about soccer.
jokes.context: Reacting to reports Trump personally contacted Infantino before a World Cup match.

jokes.topic: Team USA losing the match Trump tried to intervene in
jokes.joke: It seems like everything Trump touches dies.

jokes.topic: White House reportedly responding to her joke from the prior night about the president's bruised hands
jokes.joke: The president is very focused on issues that matter right now, and apparently, I'm one of them.
jokes.context: Meta follow-up joke after the administration reacted to her monologue.

jokes.topic: Deflecting on-air chatter about his own age-gap relationship with boyfriend Kevin Sobieski
jokes.joke: Don't put the camera on me... I'm only in a 16-year age-gap relationship.
jokes.context: Ducked behind a cue card after a Next Gen NYC cast member questioned why a woman would date a man 18-plus years older.
